answer_1.quote: We adopt a GPT-2 language model in the plan module to produce (plan) the character visual tokens.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the automatic evaluation metrics following existing works of the story visualization task and report results using the evaluation script provided in prior work. Character F1 score measures the percentages of characters obtained from the generated images that exactly appear in the story inputs. ... Frechet Inception Distance (FID) ... Video Captioning Accuracy ... R-Precision

answer_4.quote: Since automatic metrics can be insufficient in evaluating the story visualization quality, we further conduct human evaluations by asking annotators to analyze the performance of the story visualization models. We hire in total 9 Amazon Mechanical Turkers ... Visual Quality (Visual) assess the overall image quality ... Character Preservation (Character) checks the occurrences of characters.
answer_4.guideline: Workers rank visualizations on visual quality (image clarity, object/background clarity) and character preservation (presence of characters in order per story sentences).
